title: Health Education Curriculum Update on Senate Bill 288
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
Community 

News Community News

Health Education Curriculum Update - SB 288-Erin's LawThe Ohio Department of Education and Workforce (DEW), formally called the Ohio Department of Education, has shared with public schools across the state Senate Bill 288. This legislation requires that health education curricula be updated to include (K-12/developmentally appropriate) prevention education information in the areas of sexual abuse and sexual violence for students in public schools.As promised, the district is providing an opportunity for families to review the curriculum, and parents may opt their students out of the lessons if they choose.  For more information from the Ohio Department of Education- Click HERE. Instruction occurs annually. This year the district will conduct these updates with students October 12-26, 2026.K-3 Curriculum- Click HERE4-6 Curriculum- Click HERE7-8 Curriculum- TMSSocial Inclusion: Click HEREDating Violence: Click HERESuicide Prevention: Click HERE9-12 Curriculum - THS will share their videos in three successive weeks. Social Inclusion: Click HEREDating Violence / Healthy Relationships: Click HERESuicide Prevention: Click HEREContact your student's building and school counselor with any questions.

summary:
The district will conduct **Senate Bill 288 (Erin's Law) health education instruction from October 12-26, 2026**, covering sexual abuse and sexual violence prevention education (K-12). Families can review grade-level curricula through provided links covering topics like social inclusion, dating violence/healthy relationships, and suicide prevention. Parents may opt their students out by contacting their student's school counselor.

**Curriculum links available for:**
- K-3, 4-6, 7-8 (TMS), and 9-12 (THS) grade levels
- Topics: Social Inclusion, Dating Violence, Suicide Prevention

title: Miami University Mentorship Program for Juniors/Seniors
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
School 

Counseling 

Office School Counseling Office

Juniors and Seniors,We are reaching out to you regarding a new mentorship opportunity with college students at Miami University. A group of students at Miami University are starting a mentorship club connecting Talawanda High School students with current college students. If you have any questions about a certain major, life after high school, or you just want someone to talk to who has been through the college application process these Miami students would love to be a resource to you. They will be coming during Tutorial Period every other Friday, so you won't have to stay after school to participate. Before these Miami students can start coming in, they need to gauge your interest. If this is something that you would be interested in, we would love for you to fill out the form below. Mentorship Interest FormIf you have any questions, feel free to email the Miami students at hopeandafutureclub@gmail.com. Thank you!

summary: Juniors and seniors can sign up for a **mentorship program with Miami University college students** who will visit during Tutorial Period every other Friday. Mentors can answer questions about college majors, life after high school, and the application process. Interested students should fill out the **[Mentorship Interest Form](hopeandafutureclub@gmail.com)** or email hopeandafutureclub@gmail.com with questions.
